title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
_about: PROPOSED for owner review. Traditional French tune 'Ah! vous dirai-je, maman', written from the standard melody, not checked against a printed score; simple enough to check by ear. Melody in the upper octave (real recordings). The opening and closing phrases climb and fall through the scale, so the tune passes from phone to phone. Bass on the lower octave, two notes a bar, written for this arrangement. One beat = a quarter note.

_arrangements: Layouts proposed by a search that keeps every phone from ringing two notes at once and spreads quick notes between players. 1 and 2 phones play the melody only; 3 and 4 phones add the bass where it fits. Notes listed in 'alternate' sit on two phones and take turns. Spare gestures hold notes this song never uses, so a stray swing stays harmless. Sizes offered: 2, 3, 4.
